answer: Model reputation as a vouch graph in which every agent is a vertex. The instant one identity is proven sybil, the ledger retroactively prunes that vertex and cascades the revocation up each edge that vouched for it, clawing back a fixed 30% from every upstream sponsor. An honest node therefore guards its hard-won opal of reputation and refuses to vouch for strangers, so a sybil swarm finds no willing sponsor to absorb the cascade. The nectar of future rewards then flows only to deep, long-unpruned vouch-histories that a freshly minted fake cannot manufacture after the fact.
